description: Source code implementing DNS server iteration logic for both DoH and classic DNS, including classes 'DnsServerIterator', 'DohDnsServerIterator', and 'ClassicDnsServerIterator' with methods for selecting next attempt indices and checking server availability.

classes.name: DnsServerIterator
classes.description: Base class for DNS server iteration, managing common properties such as server count, attempt limits, and session context.

classes.name: DohDnsServerIterator
classes.description: Derived class implementing DNS over HTTPS (DoH) server iteration logic, including server availability checks and failure management.

classes.name: ClassicDnsServerIterator
classes.description: Derived class implementing traditional DNS server iteration logic, including server failure tracking and attempt management.

methods.name: GetNextAttemptIndex
methods.description: Selects the next DNS server index to attempt, considering failure counts and server availability, with special handling for DoH secure mode.

methods.name: AttemptAvailable
methods.description: Checks if there is any DNS server available for attempt based on current session and attempt limits.
